mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, d.specialty, s.visit_date, s.weekday, s.period, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.visit_type, s.limit_num, s.remain_num, s.stopped FROM consult_schedule s JOIN consult_doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id AND d.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY s.visit_date, s.start_time LIMIT 200
WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.visit_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY s.visit_date, s.start_time LIMIT 300
WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.visit_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY s.visit_date, s.start_time LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult_schedule (id, doctor_id, visit_date, weekday, period, start_time, end_time, visit_type, limit_num, remain_num, stopped, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{doctorId}, #{visitDate}, #{weekday}, #{period}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{visitType}, #{limitNum}, #{remainNum}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), 0)
mapper.select: WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.visit_date = #{visitDate} AND s.period = #{period} AND s.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE consult_schedule SET stopped = #{stopped}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE consult_schedule SET is_deleted = UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
